view: Zion Canyon Scenic Drive above the Grotto
where: Zion Canyon Scenic Drive (between the Grotto and Weeping Rock)
match: The drive's dark red asphalt with a double yellow centre line and no shoulders curves left into box-elder and cottonwood woods; ahead, cream-topped Navajo walls catch the first sun above shadowed red cliffs. Keep the road narrow and tucked against the canyon floor, walls rising on both sides.
licence: CC BY-SA 2.0

view: Zion Canyon Visitor Center with the Watchman behind
match: Low sandstone-and-timber building with deep wooden eaves, a glass entrance porch and a square sandstone cooling tower; the Watchman's red face and pointed spire rise just behind and left of the tower, cottonwoods frame the plaza.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: The Watchman at sunset from a Pa'rus footbridge
match: The classic sunset frame: the Virgin River leads straight away from the bridge to the Watchman's small dark pyramid on the horizon, red slopes on the left bank, bare cottonwoods on the right, pink and orange clouds. NPS asks people to shoot it from the Pa'rus footbridges, not from the Canyon Junction road bridge just upstream.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: Pa'rus Trail through the meadow toward the Watchman
match: A pale red paved path, bike-wide, curves right through knee-high golden grass and sage with a line of green cottonwoods marking the river; the Watchman's pyramid and its spire fill the skyline ahead, red benches at its foot.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: Zion Human History Museum under the Towers of the Virgin
match: Single-storey tan-brick museum with a flat roof, a long glass front under a brown steel canopy on slim posts, a flagpole and agaves in a low sandstone planter; the red-and-white striped Towers of the Virgin rise right behind the roof.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: Court of the Patriarchs above the Scenic Drive
match: Three steep sandstone peaks side by side: cream-topped Abraham on the left, Isaac in the middle, the pale tip of Jacob behind and the red bulk of Mount Moroni on the right, above autumn cottonwoods; a two-car shuttle runs along the drive at the bottom behind a low stone wall.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: Zion Lodge, its lawn and the big cottonwood
match: A broad open lawn with one giant spreading Fremont cottonwood on the left; the long, low lodge of dark timber and stone with a green roof sits at the lawn's far edge, dwarfed by a sheer red wall rising straight behind it.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: The Grotto: trail sign, parking and Angels Landing
match: Brown NPS sign with white capitals (THE GROTTO / West Rim Trail / Angels Landing / Kayenta Trail) beside the drive, a parking strip under tall bare cottonwoods, and the sunlit fin of Angels Landing rising between the trees in the middle distance.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: Big Bend: the Organ, with the Great White Throne behind
match: The knobbly red towers of the Organ fill the centre above a slope of yellowing cottonwoods, the white dome of the Great White Throne stands behind at right on red cliffs, and a pale sandbar of the river's inside bend fills the foreground.
credit: NPS Photo/Cadence C Cook, Zion National Park (Flickr)
licence: Public domain (NPS photo); the park's Flickr labels it CC BY 2.0

view: Temple of Sinawava: the Pulpit and the river
match: The Pulpit, a squat pale pillar, stands at the foot of a huge grey-red wall at left; red crags with autumn foliage on the right; the Virgin River runs shallow over grey cobbles across the foreground. End-of-the-road amphitheatre: walls close in on three sides.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: Riverside Walk: the river between closing walls
match: The shallow, clear Virgin River runs toward the camera over cobbles between a sunlit cream-and-red wall on the left and a shadowed red wall on the right; the walls pinch together upstream, a green ribbon of trees and a gravel bar along the banks.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo); the park's Flickr labels it CC BY 2.0

view: The Narrows: hikers wading upstream
where: The Narrows (bottom-up, above the Riverside Walk)
match: Grey-buff, wave-sculpted walls with a deep undercut at left, the river filling the floor between gravel bars, and small hikers wading upstream for scale; sunlight only reaches the upper walls.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: Wall Street, the narrowest stretch of the Narrows
match: Vertical walls a few metres apart and hundreds of metres high, glowing orange and pink where reflected light hits them, with the river running wall to wall; a sliver of sky only. No banks: you walk in the water.
credit: PDPhoto.org (uploaded by Y6y6y6), via Wikimedia Commons
licence: Public domain (PDPhoto.org)

view: Lower Emerald Pool and its waterfall
match: A ribbon of water pours off a projecting red sandstone lip into a small green pool with a sandy edge, framed by bright green trees; a tall varnish-streaked wall rises at right.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo)

view: One of the Middle Emerald Pools
facing: W (approx., looking down at the water)
match: A shallow, still pool on the sandstone bench with red boulders, clumps of rushes and bleached roots at its edge, the cliff and trees mirrored in the water. Colours are exaggerated by HDR processing.
licence: CC BY 2.0

view: Upper Emerald Pool under its cliff
match: A sandy beach in the foreground, a shallow green pool, and behind it a talus of red boulders at the foot of a huge cliff streaked with black varnish and seep lines.
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0

view: Weeping Rock's dripping alcove
match: Under a curving, moss-streaked overhang that drips, a sandy alcove floor with a low parapet of sandstone blocks and a pipe railing looks out over lush green trees to the red walls across the canyon.
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0

view: Angels Landing fin from the start of the West Rim Trail
where: Angels Landing (West Rim Trail from the Grotto)
match: The free-standing fin of Angels Landing, orange-red with a cream top and sheer layered faces, rises over green scrub; the paved tan trail curves toward it in the foreground.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: Walter's Wiggles switchbacks from above
match: Tight stacked switchbacks of the West Rim Trail held up by dry-laid stone retaining walls, dropping into the narrow walls of Refrigerator Canyon with trees below. Black-and-white HAER survey photo: read shapes, not colours.
credit: Historic American Engineering Record (HAER UT-40-G-5), National Park Service; Library of Congress, via Wikimedia Commons
licence: Public domain (PD-USGov-NPS, HAER survey)

view: Scout Lookout and the start of the chains
match: A sandy saddle with low green scrub in the foreground; beyond it the red fin rises with the chained route and tiny hikers on it, big walls on both sides.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: The chains along the Angels Landing ridge
match: A knife-edge spine of red sandstone with a few pines climbs to the summit, with sheer drops on both sides; a hiker on the chains at lower left gives the scale.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: View up-canyon from the top of Angels Landing
match: From the pale slickrock summit: the canyon floor far below with the Scenic Drive and the river looping through Big Bend at right, red walls on both sides topped by white-and-cream rims.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: The Great White Throne from the canyon floor
match: A colossal flat-topped monolith, grey-white above and red at its base, streaked by vertical varnish, rising straight out of spring-green trees, with red cliffs framing it left and right.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: Zion–Mount Carmel Highway switchbacks from above
where: Canyon Overlook (looking down on the switchbacks)
match: The red asphalt highway with a double yellow line folds into long hairpins across a slope of red soil dotted with juniper and scrub, cars for scale; the long legs run diagonally with tight turns at each end.
licence: CC BY 2.0

view: West portal of the Zion–Mount Carmel Tunnel
match: A round-arched portal faced with cut sandstone blocks and voussoirs, set flush into a pink-red cliff, yellow clearance signs above the arch and a 25 mph sign; the red road with its double yellow line runs into the dark bore.
licence: CC BY 3.0

view: A gallery window of the tunnel in the cliff
facing: S (approx., looking up at the cliff)
match: A wide arched opening cut into a vertical pink-red cliff streaked with dark varnish, its sill filled with stone masonry, trees below; from the switchbacks these windows read as dark holes high in the wall.
credit: An Errant Knight, via Wikimedia Commons
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0

view: Canyon Overlook Trail: the boardwalk on the cliff
match: A narrow plank walkway with rusty steel railings clings to the cliff under an overhang, above a drop into the green trees of Pine Creek.
credit: The Dye Clan (Panoramio), via Wikimedia Commons
licence: CC BY-SA 3.0

view: The view from Canyon Overlook
match: From the end of the trail: Pine Creek canyon drops away between big red walls, the highway switchbacks zig-zag on the slope below, and across Zion Canyon the white-topped Towers of the Virgin and the Streaked Wall line the horizon.
licence: Public domain (NPS photo); the park's Flickr labels it CC BY 2.0

view: Checkerboard Mesa from its viewpoint
match: A cream-buff slickrock dome scored with a grid of horizontal cross-bedding lines and vertical cracks, a second dome behind at right, pinyon-juniper and ponderosa below and the red masonry wall of the pullout in the foreground.

view: East Entrance station in winter
match: A small brown timber entrance kiosk with a gabled roof and stop signs in the middle of UT-9, snow-covered slickrock domes on the left and a buff cliff on the right, pinyon and juniper around.
licence: Public domain (NPGallery: public domain, full granting rights)

view: The pedestrian entrance footbridge and the Watchman

match: A brown steel truss footbridge on sandstone piers with a small stone tower at one end crosses the Virgin River, with the Watchman behind. Two frames side by side, during and after the December 2010 flood: ignore the brown water and match the bridge.

licence: Public domain (NPS photo); the park's Flickr labels it CC BY 2.0

view: Kolob Canyons: the finger canyons from Timber Creek Overlook Trail

match: A row of flat-topped red-orange Navajo cliffs separated by deep parallel canyons (left to right Horse Ranch Mountain, Paria Point, Beatty Point, Nagunt Mesa, Timber Top Mountain) above a scrubby ridge with junipers and autumn oak.
credit: An Errant Knight, via Wikimedia Commons
licence: CC BY-SA 4.0

view: North Guardian Angel from the Northgate Peaks viewpoint

credit: NPS Photo/Jason Burton, Zion National Park (Flickr)
licence: Public domain (NPS photo); the park's Flickr labels it CC BY 2.0

view: View from Lava Point Overlook toward Zion Canyon
